snippet.title: Deep in the Fields - Trailer 1
snippet.description:
A Rural Argentine Horror Experience

Deep in the Fields is a first-person atmospheric horror game set on a remote Argentine farm.

You arrive at an isolated rural ranch in search of work, but as you explore the property you begin to uncover unsettling secrets hidden deep within the fields.

Explore abandoned buildings, barns, and underground spaces while piecing together clues about what happened on the property. Investigate strange locations and survive the growing sense that something is watching you.

Features:

• First-person exploration in a rural Argentine setting
• Atmospheric horror and environmental storytelling
• Puzzle-solving and investigation mechanics
• Immersive environments inspired by countryside farms
• A mysterious narrative revealed through exploration
